verdict.rationale: Steel's docs describe reusing auth context to keep authenticated state across multiple sessions, so agents skip repeated logins. The product overview also explicitly lists persistent profiles as a feature. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how profiles are created, stored and reattached (API or parameters), and independent or hands-on corroboration that logged-in state reliably persists across runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist logged-in browser state in reusable profiles so agents skip the login wall on every subsequent run

citations.quote: This is particularly useful for maintaining authenticated states across multiple sessions, helping your AI agents access protected resources efficiently without repeatedly handling login processes
managed cloud browsers with stealth, residential proxies, CAPTCHA solving, persistent profiles, session replays, and agent observability.
Each session maintains its own state, cookies, and storage
